svg.title: A two-component Gaussian mixture and its responsibilities
svg.desc: A one-dimensional two-component Gaussian mixture fitted by EM to 120 points. Two dashed bell curves, each scaled by its mixing weight, add up to a solid bimodal density. Below the axis each data point is a tick coloured by its responsibility: blue on the left, orange on the right, with purple-ish ticks in the overlap region between the humps.
svg.text: tick colour = responsibility: blue = surely component 1, orange = surely component 2, in between = unsure
